episodes.title: The Beginning
episodes.summary: While facing declining sales at a book convention, bestselling mystery author Allie Chandler investigates the suspicious death of a close friend, only to clash with new police detective Jack Kerrigan and ambitious young podcaster Andi Walker.

episodes.title: The Wedding
episodes.summary: While on her first day of work, Andi learns that Allie is hosting a wedding. But before the engaged couple can tie the knot, someone drops dead. Suspecting foul play, Andie, Allie, and Jack set out to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: The Copycat
episodes.summary: A copycat killer stalks Founders Cove, mimicking murders from Allie's books. As fear grips the town, Allie, Andi, and Jack race to catch the killer before he or she strikes again.

episodes.title: The Front Window
episodes.summary: Allie and Andi retreat to remote cabins in the woods to write in peace, but distractions multiply when Allie digs into the mystery of Andi's mother. As sparks start to fly between Allie and Jack, Andi witnesses a murder that no one believes happened.

episodes.title: The Perfect Alibi
episodes.summary: A live interview with sensationalist podcaster Dean Starkweather turns shocking when news of a suicide breaks. Despite no evidence of murder, Allie, Andi, and Jack dig deeper, convinced that the truth may be far more sinister than it seems.

episodes.title: The Road Trip
episodes.summary: Armed with new information, Allie and Andi embark on a road journey to find Andi's mom. Meanwhile, as Jack and Noah investigate a recently discovered corpse, both teams encounter secrets and revelations they never saw coming.
